name: Evercraft Capability Concierge
problem: A buyer knows the desired outcome but should not need to know Evercraft's internal app or product map.
inputs: Desired outcome, constraints, existing systems and optional budget/urgency context.
outputs: The smallest evidence-backed Evercraft capability set that fits the requested outcome.
pricing: Quote required until machine-lane pricing is approved.
confirmation: Discovery/routing may be automatic. Pricing commitments, payment and consequential actions remain confirmation-gated.
invocation_status: Internal routing exists; public universal invocation is not yet advertised.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
